SchoolData.title: SchoolData
SchoolData.description: Comprehensive school assessment data including settings, grading scales, subjects, and student results

settings.description: School details, exam title, logo, and slip display configurations

gradeScale.description: Minimum score thresholds for each grade from A to F

subjects.description: Array of subject objects with id, code, and name

students.description: Array of student rows with identification, marks, teacher names, and remarks

gradeOverrides.description: Custom grade overrides mapped by student ID and subject ID

resultOverrides.description: Custom result overrides (LULUS or GAGAL) mapped by student ID

/school_data/{documentId}.description: Stores the central school assessment document loaded by all shared users and edited by teachers
